project_primary_investigator.name: project_primary_investigator
project_primary_investigator.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id AS project_unics_id,
  p.principal_investigator AS principal_investigator,
  pe.full_name AS pi_full_name
FROM projects p
LEFT JOIN people pe
  ON pe.unics_id = p.principal_investigator
project_primary_investigator.description: Mapping of a project to its principal investigator (person) with the PI's name. Useful for questions joining project metadata to people.

project_institutions_members.name: project_institutions_members
project_institutions_members.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.unics_id AS "project_members.unics_id",
  pm.project AS "project_members.project",
  pm.member_name AS "project_members.member_name",
  pm.institution_id AS "project_members.institution_id",
  pm.ec_contribution AS "project_members.ec_contribution",
  i.unics_id AS "institutions.unics_id as institution_unics_id",
  i.institutions_name AS "institutions.institutions_name",
  i.country_id AS "institutions.country_id"
FROM
  project_members pm
LEFT JOIN
  institutions i
ON
  pm.institution_id = i.unics_id
project_institutions_members.description: Denormalized project-member-institution rows linking projects to their member institutions and member contributions. One row per project member entry.

projects_row_level.name: projects_row_level
projects_row_level.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.title,
  p.start_date,
  p.end_date,
  p.start_year,
  p.end_year,
  p.total_cost,
  p.ec_max_contribution,
  p.acronym,
  p.ec_ref,
  p.framework_program
FROM projects p
projects_row_level.description: Canonical row-level projection of the projects table exposing project identifier, title, dates, and cost measures. Use this as the base cohort for project-level queries (filter by title, id, year, etc.).
validated_on: Get acronyms of projects beginning in 2018
Show the total costs of all projects
Show the title of projects with costs higher than 1000000
Show the title of projects with costs higher than a million
counter_examples: Find the projects which lasted the longest and have an end year and a start year

projects_by_title_cohort.name: projects_by_title_cohort
projects_by_title_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.title,
  p.total_cost
FROM
  projects p
WHERE
  p.title = /* put title string literal here, e.g. 'Exact Project Title' */ 'REPLACE_WITH_TITLE'
projects_by_title_cohort.description: Selectable cohort view for projects filtered or searched by exact title (exposes project id and total_cost). Intended for queries that need to look up projects by title string.

project_financials_by_project.name: project_financials_by_project
project_financials_by_project.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.total_cost,
  p.ec_max_contribution,
  (p.total_cost IS NULL) AS total_cost_is_null
FROM projects_row_level p
project_financials_by_project.description: Prepares financial measures per project (no additional aggregation beyond project row): exposes raw cost fields per project id to support later aggregations (sums, averages) grouped by other dims.

project_members_basic.name: project_members_basic
project_members_basic.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.unics_id AS unics_id,

  pm.country AS country,

FROM project_members pm
project_members_basic.description: Row-level project-member association rows exposing project id, member institution, role, country and financial contribution — useful for cohort filters and joins to projects.
validated_on: Find the id of projects with at least 100 members
Show me the title of projects which have an end year and a start year after 2006
Find member name and role code of project members in project with acronym GTBB

institutions_minimal.name: institutions_minimal

projects_rowlevel.name: projects_rowlevel

project_membership.name: project_membership

institutions_basic.name: institutions_basic

project_participants.name: project_participants
project_participants.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.project AS project,

institutions_core.name: institutions_core

institutions_geocode_region_cohort.name: institutions_geocode_region_cohort

institutions_core_14.name: institutions_core_14
institutions_core_14.body_sql:
SELECT

projects_row_level_15.name: projects_row_level_15
projects_row_level_15.body_sql:

people_normalized.name: people_normalized

projects_with_principal_investigator.name: projects_with_principal_investigator

projects_core.name: projects_core
projects_core.body_sql:
SELECT

projects_core_24.name: projects_core_24

project_topic_link.name: project_topic_link
project_topic_link.body_sql:

  pt.project::integer AS project,
  pt.topic::text AS topic
FROM
  project_topics pt
project_topic_link.description: Project-to-topic linkage: one row per project-topic pair, exposing project id and topic code for joins to topic metadata.

topics_canonical_title.name: topics_canonical_title
topics_canonical_title.body_sql:
SELECT
  t.code AS code,
  t.title AS title,

project_topics_link.name: project_topics_link
project_topics_link.body_sql:

  project_topics.project AS project,
  project_topics.topic AS topic
FROM
  project_topics
WHERE
  project_topics.project IS NOT NULL

topics_master.name: topics_master
topics_master.body_sql:
SELECT
  code,
  rcn,
  title
FROM (
  SELECT
    t.code::text AS code,
    t.rcn::text AS rcn,
    t.title::text AS title,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.code ORDER BY t.code) AS rn
  FROM topics t
) s
WHERE rn = 1
topics_master.description: Canonical topics dimension with topic code and human-readable title and rcn. One row per topic code.

projects_with_members_cohort.name: projects_with_members_cohort
projects_with_members_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id AS project_unics_id,
  -- whether there exists at least one member for the project
  (COUNT(pm.unics_id) > 0) AS has_members,
  -- count of distinct member countries per project (lift literal: include nulls? we exclude NULL country values)
  COUNT(DISTINCT pm.country) FILTER (WHERE pm.country IS NOT NULL) AS distinct_member_countries,
  -- sum of member ec contributions per project (treat NULL as 0)
  COALESCE(SUM(pm.ec_contribution), 0.0) AS total_member_ec_contribution
FROM
  projects p
LEFT JOIN
  project_members pm
    ON pm.project = p.unics_id
GROUP BY
  p.unics_id
projects_with_members_cohort.description: A project-level cohort exposing existence of members with their countries and sum of member EC contribution per project (keeps row per project to support per-project filters/aggregations).

institutions_with_country_30.name: institutions_with_country_30
institutions_with_country_30.body_sql:

projects_institution_membership.body_sql:

institutions_with_country_33.name: institutions_with_country_33
institutions_with_country_33.body_sql:

projects_by_start_year.name: projects_by_start_year
projects_by_start_year.body_sql:
SELECT
  pr.start_year,
  count(*) AS project_count
FROM
  projects_row_level pr
GROUP BY
  pr.start_year
ORDER BY

projects_by_start_year.description: Pre-aggregated counts of projects by start_year. Useful for time-series counts and year-based summaries. Groups at the project start_year level.

project_financials_by_project_35.name: project_financials_by_project_35
project_financials_by_project_35.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.total_cost,
  p.ec_max_contribution,
  -- lift no literals into view; compute difference allowing NULL semantics:
  CASE
    WHEN p.total_cost IS NULL AND p.ec_max_contribution IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN p.total_cost IS NULL THEN - p.ec_max_contribution
    WHEN p.ec_max_contribution IS NULL THEN p.total_cost
    ELSE p.total_cost - p.ec_max_contribution
  END AS total_cost_minus_ec_max_contribution
FROM projects_row_level p
project_financials_by_project_35.description: Per-project financial measures (raw totals) and relevant monetary/financial columns kept at project granularity for comparisons and aggregations. Intended for grouped analytics where projects are the grouping key.

projects_core_36.name: projects_core_36
projects_core_36.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id AS unics_id,
  p.title AS title,
  -- lift literal NULLs out of view definition (no literals here besides column references)
  pf.total_cost AS total_cost,
  pf.ec_max_contribution AS ec_max_contribution,
  p.start_date AS start_date,
  p.end_date AS end_date,
  p.start_year AS start_year,
  p.end_year AS end_year,
  p.framework_program AS framework_program
FROM projects_row_level p
LEFT JOIN project_financials_by_project pf
  ON pf.unics_id = p.unics_id
projects_core_36.description: Normalized core project attributes including financial measures and primary keys. One row per project exposing columns needed for cost-based comparisons and joins to members.

projects_with_member_links.name: projects_with_member_links

projects_with_member_links.description: Denormalized join of project members to project core attributes. One row per project member (project_members.unics_id) enriched with the project's total_cost to support cost-based cohorts and comparisons.

projects_core_38.name: projects_core_38
projects_core_38.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,

project_member_counts.name: project_member_counts
project_member_counts.body_sql:

  pm.project AS project,
  COUNT(*) AS member_count
FROM
  project_members pm

projects_row_level_40.name: projects_row_level_40
projects_row_level_40.body_sql:

FROM
  projects p

funding_schemes_canonical.name: funding_schemes_canonical
funding_schemes_canonical.description: Canonical funding scheme reference with code and human-readable title for joins and display.

projects_count_by_fundingscheme.name: projects_count_by_fundingscheme
projects_count_by_fundingscheme.body_sql:

project_costs_by_year.name: project_costs_by_year
project_costs_by_year.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.start_year,
  COALESCE(p.total_cost, pf.total_cost) AS total_cost,
  COALESCE(p.ec_max_contribution, pf.ec_max_contribution) AS ec_max_contribution
FROM
  projects_row_level p
LEFT JOIN
  project_financials_by_project pf
ON
  p.unics_id = pf.unics_id
project_costs_by_year.description: Project-level measures rolled up by project and start_year. Provides total_cost and ec_max_contribution per project-year (one row per project). Useful for time-based aggregations after applying year filters or for summing across all projects or specific years.

projects_rowlevel_basic.name: projects_rowlevel_basic
projects_rowlevel_basic.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.title,
  p.start_year,
  p.end_year,
  p.start_date,
  p.end_date,
  p.framework_program,
  p.ec_fund_scheme,
  p.ec_max_contribution,
  p.total_cost,
  pi.principal_investigator
FROM projects p
LEFT JOIN project_primary_investigator pi
  ON pi.project_unics_id = p.unics_id
projects_rowlevel_basic.description: Normalized, row-level canonical projection of the projects table with key identifiers and core date/cost fields. Useful as the base cohort for filters by start/end year, timeframe, funding, and principal investigator.

projects_with_programme_and_acronym.name: projects_with_programme_and_acronym
projects_with_programme_and_acronym.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.acronym,
  p.title,
  p.framework_program,
  p.ec_fund_scheme,
  p.start_year,
  p.end_year,
  pp.programme
FROM projects p
LEFT JOIN project_programmes pp
  ON pp.project = p.unics_id
projects_with_programme_and_acronym.description: Denormalized project-level view joining projects to programme code and acronym information, exposing project identifiers and programme membership for filtering/grouping by programme or code. One row per project.

topic_title_search_cohort.name: topic_title_search_cohort
topic_title_search_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT
  t.code AS code,
  t.title AS title
FROM
  topics t
WHERE
  t.title ILIKE -- lift literal/pattern out of view; replace the placeholder when querying
    /* {title_pattern} */ '%' || '' || '%'
GROUP BY
  t.code,
  t.title
topic_title_search_cohort.description: Selectable cohort of topics filtered by a title prefix or pattern. This is a reusable row-level filter view for topic-title-based searches (keeps one row per topic). The specific pattern is applied as a question operation, not baked into the view.

topics_row_level.name: topics_row_level
topics_row_level.body_sql:
SELECT
  t.code AS code,
  t.title AS title,
  t.rcn AS rcn
FROM topics t
topics_row_level.description: One row per topic with canonicalized title text for case-insensitive matching and search. Exposes stable topic id and textual fields used for filtering or display.

projects_with_principal_investigator_48.name: projects_with_principal_investigator_48
projects_with_principal_investigator_48.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.acronym,
  p.title,
  pi.principal_investigator,
  p.start_date,
  p.end_date,
  p.start_year,
  p.end_year
FROM
  projects_row_level p
LEFT JOIN
  project_primary_investigator pi
ON
  p.unics_id = pi.project_unics_id
projects_with_principal_investigator_48.description: One row per project exposing project identifiers and its principal investigator id (person unics_id). Useful for queries that need to relate people to projects (e.g., list people who are PIs) or to filter people by project involvement.

project_members_with_person_and_institut.name: project_members_with_person_and_institution
project_members_with_person_and_institut.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.unics_id,
  pm.project,
  pm.member_name,
  pm.institution_id,
  pm.ec_contribution,
  pm.country,
  pm.city,
  pm.member_role
FROM project_members pm
project_members_with_person_and_institut.description: One row per project member (membership record) linking member identity, project reference, member's institution and basic location/economic columns. Useful to answer questions about people participating in projects and to relate people to institutions and projects.

projects_with_program_and_acronym.name: projects_with_program_and_acronym
projects_with_program_and_acronym.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.acronym,
  p.title,
  pp.programme,
  p.framework_program,
  pi.principal_investigator
FROM projects_row_level p
LEFT JOIN project_programmes pp
  ON pp.project = p.unics_id
LEFT JOIN project_primary_investigator pi
  ON pi.project_unics_id = p.unics_id
projects_with_program_and_acronym.description: Denormalized project rows including programme code/title and principal investigator reference where available — useful for filtering or grouping by programme or PI alongside project measures.

project_financials_basic.name: project_financials_basic
project_financials_basic.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.total_cost,
  p.ec_max_contribution,
  (p.total_cost IS NULL) AS total_cost_is_null
FROM projects_row_level p
project_financials_basic.description: Projection of project financial measures and identifying keys. Useful as a cohort for queries that filter or aggregate by cost or EC contribution.

project_titles.name: project_titles
project_titles.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.title
FROM
  projects p
WHERE
  p.title IS NOT NULL
project_titles.description: Simple projection of project id to title, excluding NULL titles (convenient when queries need project names).

project_with_program_and_pi.name: project_with_program_and_pi
project_with_program_and_pi.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.title,
  p.framework_program,
  p.ec_fund_scheme,
  pp.programme,
  pi.principal_investigator
FROM projects p
LEFT JOIN project_programmes pp
  ON pp.project = p.unics_id
LEFT JOIN project_primary_investigator pi
  ON pi.project_unics_id = p.unics_id
project_with_program_and_pi.description: Denormalized project row that joins project basic info with programme and principal investigator id to support filters/grouping by programme or PI.

project_members_core.name: project_members_core
project_members_core.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.unics_id AS unics_id,
  pm.project AS project,
  pm.member_name AS member_name,
  pm.member_role AS member_role,
  pm.institution_id AS institution_id,
  pm.ec_contribution AS ec_contribution,
  pm.country AS country,
  pm.member_short_name AS member_short_name,
  pm.member_name AS member_name
FROM project_members pm
project_members_core.description: Normalized row-level projection of project_members exposing identifying keys and commonly queried attributes about a project's member (one row per project-member relationship). Cleans nothing here but exposes raw relevant columns for downstream filters and joins.

project_member_role_cohort.name: project_member_role_cohort
project_member_role_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.unics_id,
  pm.project,
  pm.member_name,
  pm.member_role,
  pm.institution_id,
  pm.country
FROM
  project_members_basic pm
WHERE
  pm.member_role = 'partner'
project_member_role_cohort.description: Cohort view selecting project members by role; one row per project member (same grain as project_members). Intended to be reused for any role-based filtering (e.g., 'partner', 'coordinator').

erc_research_domains_canonical.name: erc_research_domains_canonical
erc_research_domains_canonical.body_sql:
SELECT
  code,
  trim(both ' ' FROM nullif(description, '')) AS description
FROM erc_research_domains
erc_research_domains_canonical.description: Canonical projection of ERC research domains exposing identifier and human-readable description, with trimmed/normalized text for reuse in joins and display.

erc_research_domain_lookup_for_join.name: erc_research_domain_lookup_for_join
erc_research_domain_lookup_for_join.description: Lightweight lookup table of ERC research domain code -> description for joining to projects or other domain-assigned tables; preserves code primary key for safe joins.

institutions_with_country_58.name: institutions_with_country_58
institutions_with_country_58.body_sql:
SELECT
  i.unics_id,
  i.institutions_name,
  c.unics_id AS country_id,
  c.country_name
FROM institutions i
JOIN countries c ON i.country_id = c.unics_id
institutions_with_country_58.description: Denormalized view joining institutions to their country rows so each institution row includes its country_name and country codes. One row per institution that has a matching country (inner join).

institutions_with_country_59.name: institutions_with_country_59
institutions_with_country_59.body_sql:
SELECT
  i.unics_id AS unics_id,
  i.institutions_name AS institutions_name,
  c.country_name AS country_name,
  c.unics_id AS country_id
FROM institutions i
LEFT JOIN countries c
  ON i.country_id = c.unics_id
institutions_with_country_59.description: Denormalized row per institution with its matched country name and country identifiers. Useful for questions that need institution details alongside country labels.

funding_schemes_core.name: funding_schemes_core
funding_schemes_core.body_sql:
SELECT
  fs.code AS code,
  fs.title AS title
FROM
  funding_schemes fs
funding_schemes_core.description: One row per funding scheme, exposing its primary code and human title for lookup and joins.

projects_with_funding_scheme.name: projects_with_funding_scheme
projects_with_funding_scheme.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.acronym,
  p.title,
  p.ec_fund_scheme,
  p.ec_fund_scheme AS funding_scheme_code,
  fs.title AS funding_scheme_title
FROM projects p
LEFT JOIN funding_schemes fs
  ON p.ec_fund_scheme = fs.code
projects_with_funding_scheme.description: Project-level rows joined to their funding scheme code and title to enable filtering or aggregation by scheme.

funding_scheme_lookup_normalized.name: funding_scheme_lookup_normalized
funding_scheme_lookup_normalized.body_sql:
SELECT
  fs.code AS code,
  -- canonicalize title: trim surrounding whitespace; treat empty-string as NULL; coalesce NULL to ''
  -- Lifted literal: '' (empty string used for null canonical fallback)
  COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(fs.title), ''), '') AS title_canonical
FROM funding_schemes fs
funding_scheme_lookup_normalized.description: Normalized/cleaned funding scheme rows: trims title and canonicalizes NULLs, exposing code and cleaned title for robust text comparisons.

programmes_core.name: programmes_core
programmes_core.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.title AS title,
  NULL::text AS short_name,
  p.code AS code,
  p.rcn AS rcn,
  p.parent AS parent
FROM programmes p
programmes_core.description: Canonical normalized programme rows exposing programme identifiers, titles and short name for joining and filtering. Performs no aggregation; preserves one row per programme.

programmes_with_hierarchy.name: programmes_with_hierarchy
programmes_with_hierarchy.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.code,
  p.title,
  p.short_name,
  p.parent,
  parent_p.title AS parent_title
FROM
  programmes p
LEFT JOIN
  programmes parent_p
ON
  p.parent = parent_p.code
programmes_with_hierarchy.description: Programme rows enriched with their parent programme's code and title (if any). Useful for questions about programme titles, short names and parent relationships.

projects_basic.name: projects_basic
projects_basic.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.acronym,
  p.title,
  p.start_date,
  p.end_date,
  p.start_year,
  p.end_year
FROM projects p
projects_basic.description: One row per project with basic identifiers and timeline fields to filter or join projects by acronym, id, year, and fund scheme.

project_member_with_project.name: project_member_with_project
project_member_with_project.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.unics_id AS unics_id,
  pm.member_name AS member_name,
  pm.member_role AS member_role,
  pm.project AS project,
  p.unics_id AS "projects.unics_id",
  p.acronym AS "projects.acronym"
FROM project_members pm
JOIN projects p
  ON pm.project = p.unics_id
project_member_with_project.description: Denormalized view joining project_members to their project basic row so queries can filter by project attributes (acronym, years) while still returning member-level rows.
